# Oklahoma Bar Association

> The Oklahoma Bar Association serves as the professional organization for Oklahoma attorneys, providing member resources, public legal services, professional development, and disciplinary oversight.

Founded in 1904, the OBA is the primary governing body for the legal profession in Oklahoma, offering continuing legal education, practice management support, ethics guidance, and access to justice programs for both members and the public.

## Key Topics

- Oklahoma Bar Association
- Member Resources
- Continuing Legal Education (CLE)
- Professional Development
- Legal Ethics
- Practice Management

## Core Resources

- [Home - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org): Homepage for Oklahoma Bar Association with member resources and events
- [About - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/about): History and governance structure of Oklahoma Bar Association since 1904
- [Members - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/members): Member resources hub including Bar Journal, benefits, and CLE information
- [Public - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/public): Public resources for bar admission, lawyer search, and legal information

## Member Services & Professional Development

- [Login Required](https://ams.okbar.org/eweb/DynamicPage.aspx): Member portal login for accessing Fastcase, CLE, and MCLE resources
- [Bar Journal - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/barjournal): Official Oklahoma Bar Journal publication with theme issues and archives
- [OBA Midyear Meeting – Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/midyear): Annual midyear conference with CLE credit and practice management sessions
- [Events - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/events): Events calendar with CLE meetings, committee events, and professional development
- [Management Assistance Program - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/map): Practice management advisory services for law office operations and technology

## Legal Ethics & Professional Conduct

- [Ethics Counsel - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/ec): Ethics counsel advisory opinions and professional guidance for attorneys
- [Lawyer Complaint Process - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/gc/complaint): Process for filing complaints against attorneys and disciplinary procedures

## Public Legal Services & Access to Justice

- [Find a Lawyer - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/findalawyer): Lawyer directory and referral services for public legal resource needs
- [Legal Resources - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/legalresources): Legal assistance programs including free legal answers and estate planning
- [Free Legal Information - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/freelegalinfo): Free legal brochures, videos, and resources on various legal topics
- [Oklahoma Law for People – Free information and resources for the public](https://www.okbar.org/a2j): Access to justice resources and free legal information for Oklahoma public

## Member Support & Wellness

- [Lawyers Helping Lawyers - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/lhl): Confidential counseling and support services for lawyer wellness and crisis

## Optional

- [CLASSIFIEDS: Membership Service - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/classifieds): Job listings and classified ads for legal positions in Oklahoma
- [County Bar Chairpersons - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/lawday/countychairpersons): Law Day resources and planning guide for county bar association chairs
- [Title Examination Standards Handbook Committee CLE/Meeting - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/event/title-examination-standards-handbook-committee-cle-meeting-3): Committee CLE meeting on title examination standards via Zoom or in-person
- [Family Law Section CLE/Meeting - Oklahoma Bar Association](https://www.okbar.org/event/family-law-section-cle-meeting-13): Family law section CLE meeting with hybrid attendance options
